prompt: Title (top): "같은 결손, 서로 다른 상태 선택" + smaller warm-grey "FBA · MOMA · ROOM". Draw exactly three aligned columns headed "FBA", "MOMA", and "ROOM", with no panel letters or color-code tags. One shared top bar spanning all columns says "같은 모델·배지·결손". The FBA column contains exactly "목적 재최적화" and "WT 기준 불필요". The MOMA column contains exactly "거리 최소" and "WT 기준 필요". The ROOM column contains exactly "변화 반응 수 최소" and "WT 기준·임계값 필요". One bottom bar spanning all columns says "바이오매스 플럭스 별도 비교" with one red underline. Use only abstract icons without internal text. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every bar, column, tag, icon, and underline has one perfectly uniform solid fill or stroke. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; never render hex color codes, "A", "B", "C", "Mutant", rankings, numbers, or other text.
